question: The maximum temperature of the day occurs generally ___________.
solution:
The correct answer__** is in the afternoon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The maximum temperature of the day occurs generally in the afternoon while the minimum temperature occurs generally in the early morning
 
• Daily air temperatures at Earth's surface are controlled by the incoming and outgoing energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• During the day, the air temperature increases as energy gains exceed the energy lost from Earth's surface.
 
• Throughout the night, the air temperature decreases as Earth's surface loses more energy than it receives
